 if(kind==='bike')return PHOTO_ASSETS.bike[variant]||PHOTO_ASSETS.bike.bike1;

 if(kind==='architecture')return PHOTO_ASSETS.architecture;
 return PHOTO_ASSETS.travel;
}

const ZOOM={garden:1.9,cliff:1.7,sunset:1.5,plan2:1.7,plan3:1.5,river:1.8,island:1.6,coast:1.8,atelier:1.5,detail:1.4,tennis:1.6,spa:2.1,dine:1.9,cultural:1.7};
const image=(kind,variant,alt,cls)=>{
 const hero=variant==='hero';
 const focus=kind==='bike'?'50% 50%':kind==='resort'?(variant==='villa'?'50% 64%':variant==='garden'?'28% 42%':variant==='cliff'?'78% 34%':'58% 50%'):kind==='realty'?(variant==='plan1'?'34% 52%':variant==='plan2'?'58% 42%':'78% 56%'):kind==='travel'?(variant==='sapa'?'32% 46%':variant==='river'?'54% 68%':variant==='island'?'78% 48%':'52% 50%'):kind==='architecture'?(variant==='house'?'24% 48%':variant==='coast'?'70% 42%':'52% 46%'):'52% 50%';
 return '<img class="'+(cls||'')+' photo-asset" data-photo="'+esc(kind+'-'+variant)+'" src="'+photoFor(kind,variant)+'" alt="'+esc(alt)+'" loading="'+(hero?'eager':'lazy')+'" decoding="async"'+(hero?' fetchpriority="high"':'')+' style="object-position:'+focus+';transform-origin:'+focus+(ZOOM[variant]?';scale:'+ZOOM[variant]:'')+'">';
};

 const polishCSS=`
/* CANVIO 19.1.1 · photo-led art direction and reliable preview visibility */
.hero{min-height:min(780px,88vh);padding-top:138px;padding-bottom:112px}
.hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;filter:saturate(.94) contrast(1.025);transform:scale(1.035);animation:hero-photo-drift 30s ease-in-out infinite alternate;will-change:transform}
@keyframes hero-photo-drift{from{transform:scale(1.035) translate3d(-.25%,0,0)}to{transform:scale(1.095) translate3d(.35%,-.4%,0)}}
/* Visible by default: never leave empty sections when the preview iframe does not scroll. */
.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;visibility:visible}
.reveal.visible{animation:section-enter .72s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.reveal.delay1{animation-delay:.08s}.reveal.delay2{animation-delay:.16s}
@keyframes section-enter{from{opacity:.35;transform:translate3d(0,14px,0)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.feature-card .visual,.gallery .visual,.split .visual{background:#d9ded9;isolation:isolate}
.feature-card .visual img,.gallery .visual img,.split .visual img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;filter:saturate(.94);transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),filter .5s}
.feature-card:hover .visual img,.gallery .visual:hover img{transform:scale(1.045);filter:saturate(1.04)}
.booking{border:1px solid rgba(21,46,55,.08);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 20px 54px rgba(17,37,47,.16)}
.site-nav{padding-top:28px;padding-bottom:28px}
.site-nav .brand{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.18em}
.nav-links{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em}
.section{padding-block:clamp(70px,7.5vw,112px)}
.section-top{margin-bottom:34px}
.feature-card .visual{aspect-ratio:1.28}
.feature-card h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2vw,28px)}
.metrics{border-color:var(--line)}
.price-tag{border-radius:2px}
.hero .button,.final-cta .button{border-radius:0}
.bike-hero{min-height:760px;background:#f2f1ed}
.bike-hero .hero-media img{filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.04);opacity:.95}
.bike-hero:after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(244,243,238,.97),rgba(244,243,238,.34) 58%,rgba(244,243,238,.03))}
.architecture-hero .hero-media img{filter:saturate(.78) contrast(1.08)}
@media(max-width:900px){.hero{min-height:760px}.section{padding-block:72px}}
@media(max-width:650px){.hero{min-height:720px;padding-top:120px;padding-bottom:92px}.site-nav{padding:18px 20px}.feature-card .visual{aspect-ratio:1.35}}

/* CANVIO 19.2 · reference sections */
.visual{overflow:hidden}
.x-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:0;max-width:var(--content);margin:70px auto 0;padding:0 var(--pad)}
.x-strip>div{display:grid;gap:4px;padding:6px 22px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}.x-strip>div:first-child{border:0;padding-left:0}
.x-strip svg{color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px}.x-strip b{font-size:13px}.x-strip span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.x-tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.x-tile .visual{aspect-ratio:.9;background:#d9ded9}.x-tile img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s}
.x-tile h3{font:400 21px var(--serif);margin:14px 0 2px}.x-tile p{margin:0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.x-adv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:clamp(28px,5vw,80px);align-items:center}
.x-adv h2{font:400 clamp(28px,3.4vw,46px)/1.1 var(--serif);margin:10px 0 24px}
.x-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid}.x-list li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:15px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.x-list b{font-size:14px}.x-list span{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);text-align:right}
.x-quote{margin:0;padding:34px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}.x-quote blockquote{margin:0 0 20px;font:italic 400 21px/1.5 var(--serif)}.x-quote figcaption{display:grid;gap:2px;font-size:13px}.x-quote span{color:var(--muted)}.x-quote i{font-style:normal;color:#b8801c;margin-top:6px}
.x-offer{background:#152e37;color:#f3f0e8;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,84px) var(--pad)}.x-offer-in{max-width:var(--content);margin:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr auto;gap:36px;align-items:center}
.x-offer h2{font:400 clamp(26px,3vw,40px)/1.15 var(--serif);margin:8px 0}.x-offer p{margin:0;opacity:.75}
.x-count{display:flex;gap:10px}.x-count div{min-width:62px;text-align:center;padding:12px 6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22)}.x-count b{display:block;font:400 28px var(--serif)}.x-count span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.7}
.x-acc{margin-top:26px}.x-acc details{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 0}.x-acc summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;list-style:none}.x-acc em{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent)}.x-acc p{margin:10px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.x-why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}.x-why>div{display:grid;gap:6px;padding:26px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}.x-why svg{color:var(--accent)}.x-why strong{font:400 34px var(--serif)}.x-why span{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.x-pack{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}.x-pack article{display:grid;gap:8px;padding:28px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}.x-pack article.hot{background:#152e37;color:#fff}.x-pack em{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;opacity:.65}.x-pack strong{font:400 30px var(--serif)}.x-pack span{font-size:13px;opacity:.75;margin-bottom:10px}
@media(max-width:900px){.x-strip{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}.x-strip>div{border:0;padding:0}.x-tiles{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.x-adv,.x-offer-in,.x-why,.x-pack{grid-template-columns:1fr}.x-list li{flex-direction:column;gap:2px}.x-list span{text-align:left}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.hero-media img{animation:none!important;transform:none!important}.reveal,.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none;animation:none!important}.feature-card .visual img,.gallery .visual img{transition:none!important}}
`;
 const img=(kind,variant,alt,cls)=>image(kind,variant,alt,cls);
 const nav=(brand,labels,light)=>`<header class="site-nav ${light?'light':''}"><a class="brand" href="#top">${esc(brand)}<small>DESIGNED WITH INTENTION</small></a><nav class="nav-links">${labels.map(x=>`<a href="#${x[0]}">${esc(x[1])}</a>`).join('')}</nav><a class="nav-cta" href="#contact">${esc(d.cta)}</a><button class="nav-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Mở menu" aria-expanded="false">Menu</button></header>`;
 const metrics=()=>`<div class="metrics">${d.metric.map(x=>`<div class="metric reveal"><strong>${esc(x[0])}</strong><span>${esc(x[1])}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
 const card=(x,i)=>`<article class="feature-card reveal ${i%3===1?'delay1':i%3===2?'delay2':''}"><div class="visual">${img(x[3],x[4],x[0])}</div><h3>${esc(x[0])}</h3><p>${esc(x[1])}</p><div class="meta"><span>${esc(x[2])}</span><span>↗</span></div></article>`;
 let body='',navHtml='',heroClass='';
 if(id==='skyview-resort'){
  navHtml=nav(d.brand,[['stay','Lưu trú'],['experience','Trải nghiệm'],['gallery','Thư viện'],['story','Câu chuyện']],false);
  heroClass='';body=`<section class="hero" id="top"><div class="hero-media" data-parallax>${img('resort','hero','Toàn cảnh khu nghỉ dưỡng ven biển')}</div><div class="hero-inner reveal visible"><p class="eyebrow">${esc(d.tag)}</p><h1>${esc(d.title)}</h1><p>${esc(d.sub)}</p><a class="button" href="#stay">${esc(d.cta)} <span>↗</span></a><div style="margin-top:30px"><span class="hero-badge">✦ Kỳ nghỉ được tuyển chọn · Bãi Dài</span></div></div><span class="scroll-cue">Scroll to discover ↓</span></section>
  <div class="booking"><div><label>Điểm đến</label><b>${esc(d.location)}</b></div><div><label>Nhận phòng</label><b>Chọn ngày đến</b></div><div><label>Số khách</label><b>02 người lớn · 01 phòng</b></div><a class="button" href="#stay">Tìm kỳ nghỉ <span>↗</span></a></div>
  ${extra(id,"strip")}<section class="section" id="story"><div class="split"><div class="split-copy reveal"><p class="kicker">A DIFFERENT KIND OF ESCAPE</p><h2>Nơi thời gian chậm lại, để bạn gần nhau hơn.</h2><p>Ẩn mình giữa triền xanh và mặt biển rộng mở, Skyview tạo nên khoảng riêng cho những ngày nghỉ trọn vẹn: thức dậy cùng nắng sớm, dùng bữa bên hiên gió và kết thúc ngày bằng sắc trời cuối chiều.</p><div class="list"><div><b>01 · Stay</b><span>Không gian riêng tư</span></div><div><b>02 · Taste</b><span>Ẩm thực theo mùa</span></div><div><b>03 · Restore</b><span>Spa & wellness</span></div></div></div><div class="visual reveal delay1">${img('resort','cliff','Villa trên triền biển')}</div></div></section>
  <section class="section" id="stay"><div class="section-top"><div><p class="kicker">STAY A LITTLE LONGER</p><h2>Rooms & private suites</h2></div><p class="section-intro">Mỗi không gian được thiết kế để mở rộng tầm nhìn, đón ánh sáng tự nhiên và giữ lại sự riêng tư cần thiết.</p></div><div class="cards">${d.rooms.map(card).join('')}</div><p style="margin-top:24px"><a class="button" href="#contact">Xem tất cả hạng phòng ↗</a></p></section>
  <div class="dark-band"><section class="section" id="experience"><div class="section-top"><div><p class="kicker">MORE THAN A STAY</p><h2>Small moments. Lasting memories.</h2></div><p class="section-intro">Những trải nghiệm được tạo ra để cảm nhận bằng mọi giác quan, không cần một lịch trình vội vã.</p></div>${metrics()}<div class="gallery" style="margin-top:42px"><div class="visual">${img('resort','sunset','Hoàng hôn trên vịnh')}</div><div class="visual">${img('resort','garden','Vườn nghỉ dưỡng')}</div><div class="visual">${img('resort','cliff','Kiến trúc hướng biển')}</div></div></section></div>
  <section class="section" id="gallery"><div class="quote reveal"><p class="kicker">A NOTE FROM OUR GUESTS</p><blockquote>“Có những nơi không chỉ để đến. Mà để nhớ cảm giác mình đã ở đó.”</blockquote><small>Guest journal · Skyview Coast Retreat</small></div></section>

var tg=$('.nav-toggle'),nv=$('.nav-links');if(tg&&nv){tg.addEventListener('click',function(){var o=nv.classList.toggle('open');tg.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(o))});$$('a',nv).forEach(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',function(){nv.classList.remove('open');tg.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')})})}
function fmt(v,dec){return dec?v.toFixed(dec).replace('.',','):Math.round(v).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}
function count(el){var to=parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-count')),dec=(String(to).split('.')[1]||'').length,suf=el.getAttribute('data-suf')||'',pre=el.getAttribute('data-pre')||'',t0=null;if(red)return;function f(t){if(!t0)t0=t;var p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/1400),e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);el.textContent=pre+fmt(to*e,dec)+suf;if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f)}requestAnimationFrame(f)}
var all=$$('.reveal,[data-count]');if(!('IntersectionObserver'in window)||red){all.forEach(function(n){n.classList.add('visible')})}else{var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(!e.isIntersecting)return;e.target.classList.add('visible');if(e.target.hasAttribute('data-count'))count(e.target);io.unobserve(e.target)})},{threshold:.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -4% 0px'});all.forEach(function(n){io.observe(n)})}
$$('[data-scrolly]').forEach(function(s){var busy=false;function u(){busy=false;var r=s.getBoundingClientRect(),p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,-r.top/Math.max(1,r.height-innerHeight)));s.style.setProperty('--p',p.toFixed(3));s.classList.toggle('on',p>.5)}addEventListener('scroll',function(){if(!busy){busy=true;requestAnimationFrame(u)}},{passive:true});u()});
$$('[data-demo-form]').forEach(function(f){f.addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();var o=$('.form-ok',f);if(o)o.classList.add('on')})});
$$('[data-step]').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var o=$('[data-party]'),n=Math.max(1,Math.min(12,(parseInt(o.textContent,10)||2)+parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-step'),10)));o.textContent=n})});
$$('[data-chips]').forEach(function(g){var out=$(g.getAttribute('data-out'));$$('button',g).forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){$$('button',g).forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false')});b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');if(out&&b.hasAttribute('data-price'))out.textContent=b.getAttribute('data-price')})})});
$$('.glow').forEach(function(c){c.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){var r=c.getBoundingClientRect();c.style.setProperty('--mx',(e.clientX-r.left)+'px');c.style.setProperty('--my',(e.clientY-r.top)+'px')})});
$$('[data-add]').forEach(function(b){var n=0,c=$('[data-cart]');b.addEventListener('click',function(){n++;if(c)c.textContent=n;b.textContent='Đã thêm '+n+' · Thêm nữa'})});
})();`;

/* ---------- SVG minh họa cục bộ ---------- */
function burger(o){o=o||{};const p=o.patties||1,ch=o.cheese||'#f5b82e';let y=300,s='';
 s+=`<ellipse cx="200" cy="338" rx="150" ry="14" fill="#000" opacity=".35"/>`;
 s+=`<path d="M62 296q0 36 44 36h188q44 0 44-36z" fill="#b8742a"/><path d="M62 296q0 14 20 22h236q20-8 20-22z" fill="#d79a4c" opacity=".55"/>`;
 y=296;let ct=y;
 for(let i=0;i<p;i++){y-=i?40:30;s+=`<rect x="54" y="${y}" width="292" height="34" rx="16" fill="#4a2615"/><rect x="62" y="${y+5}" width="276" height="8" rx="4" fill="#7a3f1f" opacity=".7"/>`;
  s+=`<path d="M50 ${y-6}h300l-14 22-26-10-18 28-24-22-52 10-26-16-44 12-26-16-26 12z" fill="${ch}"/>`;ct=y-6}
 y=ct;
 if(o.bacon){y-=4;s+=`<path d="M52 ${y+14}q20-18 40 0t40 0 40 0 40 0 40 0 40 0 40 0 20 0v10q-20 12-40 0t-40 0-40 0-40 0-40 0-40 0-40 0-20 0z" fill="#b8332a"/>`;y-=10}
 if(o.pickle){for(let i=0;i<5;i++)s+=`<ellipse cx="${92+i*54}" cy="${y+8}" rx="22" ry="7" fill="#7ea834"/>`;y-=10}
 y-=26;s+=`<path d="M48 ${y+14}q20-18 40 0t40 0 40 0 40 0 40 0 40 0 40 0 26 0v14H48z" fill="#6fae3c"/><rect x="60" y="${y+22}" width="280" height="12" rx="6" fill="#d9442f"/>`;
 if(o.sauce)s+=`<rect x="70" y="${y+30}" width="260" height="8" rx="4" fill="#e8742a"/>`;
 const t=y-6;
 s+=`<path d="M64 ${t+6}C58 ${t-86} 140 ${t-140} 200 ${t-140}S342 ${t-86} 336 ${t+6}Z" fill="url(#bun)"/><path d="M110 ${t-60}C130 ${t-100} 170 ${t-118} 210 ${t-120}" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity=".25"/>`;
 [[150,-96,-20],[200,-112,10],[250,-98,30],[120,-60,15],[178,-76,-10],[232,-70,25],[282,-56,-30]].forEach(a=>s+=`<ellipse cx="${a[0]}" cy="${t+a[1]}" rx="9" ry="4.5" fill="#f6e2b3" transform="rotate(${a[2]} ${a[0]} ${t+a[1]})"/>`);
 const top=Math.max(0,t-190);
 return `<svg viewBox="0 ${top} 400 ${350-top}" role="img" aria-label="${esc(o.label||'Burger SMASH')}"><defs><linearGradient id="bun${o.id||''}" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#e8ad52"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b8742a"/></linearGradient></defs>${s.replace(/url\(#bun\)/g,'url(#bun'+(o.id||'')+')')}${o.steam?`<g class="steam" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".35"><path d="M150 ${top+8}q-14-16 0-32t0-32"/><path d="M200 ${top+2}q-14-16 0-32t0-32" style="animation-delay:.6s"/><path d="M250 ${top+8}q-14-16 0-32t0-32" style="animation-delay:1.2s"/></g>`:''}</svg>`}
function bottle(id){return `<svg viewBox="0 0 200 360" role="img" aria-label="Chai Ámbar Serum 30 ml"><defs><linearGradient id="gl${id}" x1="0" x2="1"><stop stop-color="#ffb347"/><stop offset=".55" stop-color="#d9690f"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8f3a05"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="rb${id}" x2="1"><stop stop-color="#fff7ee"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e9d9c6"/></linearGradient></defs><ellipse cx="100" cy="338" rx="74" ry="9" fill="#000" opacity=".22"/><rect x="82" y="104" width="36" height="40" fill="#2b160c"/><rect x="72" y="136" width="56" height="14" rx="4" fill="#3a1d0e"/><rect x="55" y="146" width="90" height="190" rx="20" fill="url(#gl${id})"/><rect x="66" y="156" width="10" height="164" rx="5" fill="#fff" opacity=".35"/><rect x="66" y="238" width="68" height="86" rx="6" fill="#fff6ee"/><text x="100" y="268" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="15" letter-spacing="2" fill="#c2410c">ÁMBAR</text><text x="100" y="284" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="6" letter-spacing="1" fill="#5b3a29">VITAMIN C SERUM</text><text x="100" y="312" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="7" fill="#5b3a29">15% · 30 ML</text><rect x="86" y="30" width="28" height="82" rx="14" fill="url(#rb${id})"/><path d="M92 104v26M108 104v26" stroke="#e08a2e" stroke-width="3"/></svg>`}
function avatar(){return `<svg viewBox="0 0 220 220" role="img" aria-label="Chân dung Scarlett Rose"><defs><linearGradient id="av" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#c4b5fd"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#7c3aed"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="220" height="220" fill="url(#av)"/><path d="M30 220c4-52 38-72 80-72s76 20 80 72z" fill="#1f1536"/><path d="M92 140h36v26q-18 12-36 0z" fill="#e9b392"/><ellipse cx="110" cy="100" rx="42" ry="50" fill="#f2c4a8"/><path d="M64 104C54 48 90 28 114 30c40 2 56 38 44 78-6-26-18-40-44-40-24 0-40 14-50 36z" fill="#2a1535"/><path d="M62 100c-10 40 0 72 14 82-2-30 0-54 6-72z" fill="#2a1535"/><path d="M158 100c10 40 0 72-14 82 2-30 0-54-6-72z" fill="#2a1535"/><circle cx="94" cy="104" r="3.4" fill="#2a1535"/><circle cx="126" cy="104" r="3.4" fill="#2a1535"/><path d="M98 124q12 10 24 0" stroke="#b4503f" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="84" cy="118" r="7" fill="#f0907f" opacity=".35"/><circle cx="136" cy="118" r="7" fill="#f0907f" opacity=".35"/></svg>`}
function flat(){return `<svg viewBox="0 0 520 380" role="img" aria-label="Ép patty trên flat-top 230°C"><defs><linearGradient id="plate" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#3a3a3d"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1c1c1e"/></linearGradient><radialGradient id="heat" cx=".5" cy=".6" r=".6"><stop stop-color="#ff7a1a" stop-opacity=".55"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ff7a1a" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient></defs><rect width="520" height="380" fill="#0f0f10"/><ellipse cx="260" cy="270" rx="250" ry="90" fill="url(#heat)"/><path d="M20 250 70 200h380l50 50v80H20z" fill="url(#plate)"/><path d="M20 250h480" stroke="#e3c15a" stroke-opacity=".5"/><g class="patty"><ellipse cx="260" cy="236" rx="78" ry="30" fill="#4a2615"/><ellipse cx="260" cy="230" rx="70" ry="22" fill="#7a3f1f"/><ellipse cx="236" cy="224" rx="20" ry="5" fill="#c58a4c" opacity=".7"/></g><g class="spatula"><rect x="150" y="100" width="220" height="26" rx="4" fill="#cfd2d6"/><rect x="150" y="100" width="220" height="7" fill="#fff" opacity=".5"/><rect x="360" y="108" width="140" height="12" rx="6" fill="#222"/></g><g fill="#ffb24a">${[[170,214],[210,196],[320,200],[360,220],[290,186],[240,250]].map((a,i)=>`<circle class="spark" cx="${a[0]}" cy="${a[1]}" r="3" style="animation-delay:${i*.23}s"/>`).join('')}</g></svg>`}
function skin(){return `<svg viewBox="0 0 600 600" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" aria-hidden="true" class="skin-svg"><defs><radialGradient id="sk" cx=".4" cy=".35" r=".9"><stop stop-color="#f6cfc3"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e49a8c"/></radialGradient><filter id="pore"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency=".9" numOctaves="2" seed="4"/><feColorMatrix values="0 0 0 0 .55  0 0 0 0 .25  0 0 0 0 .2  0 0 0 .45 0"/></filter><filter id="blur"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.2"/></filter></defs><rect width="600" height="600" fill="url(#sk)"/><rect width="600" height="600" filter="url(#pore)" opacity=".5"/>${[[120,140,22],[210,380,16],[430,170,26],[470,420,19],[330,250,12],[90,470,14],[520,300,10],[260,90,11]].map(a=>`<circle class="spot" cx="${a[0]}" cy="${a[1]}" r="${a[2]}" fill="#6b2d22" filter="url(#blur)"/>`).join('')}</svg>`}

/* Ảnh cắt từ video tham khảo (WebP nhúng cục bộ, chỉ vùng nội dung, đã bỏ chữ/viền clip) */
const IMG={"bottle": "data:image/webp;base64,", "ripple": "data:image/webp;base64,", "before": "data:image/webp;base64,
